The Science
How Profhilo Works
Bio-Remodelling at Its Finest
NAHYCOÂ® Technology Â· BAP Technique Â· Natural Results

NAHYCOÂ® Hybrid Technology

Profhilo is produced using IBSA's patented NAHYCOÂ® technology â a thermal process that bonds high- and low-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid without any chemical cross-linking agents. This results in a uniquely pure, hybrid HA gel with prolonged stimulating activity in the skin.

Collagen & Elastin Stimulation

The high concentration of HA in Profhilo stimulates the four key types of collagen and elastin in the skin â improving firmness, elasticity, and texture from the inside out. This creates progressive, natural-looking improvements that continue to develop over several weeks after treatment.

BAP â Bio Aesthetic Points Technique

At ISAAC Luxe, Profhilo is administered using the IBSA-approved BAP (Bio Aesthetic Points) technique â a standardised method of 5 precise injection points on each side of the face. This ensures optimal diffusion of Profhilo across the treatment area with fewer injections, maximum comfort, and no post-injection massage required.

Deep Hydration & Skin Laxity

Profhilo spreads evenly beneath the skin, deeply hydrating the dermis and attracting water within the skin's deeper layers. It is particularly effective for skin laxity â addressing the looseness and crepiness that conventional fillers and creams cannot reach.

Your Experience
The Procedure, Step by Step
What Happens During Your Session
Simple Â· Comfortable Â· Transformative
1

Personalised Skin Consultation

At ISAAC Luxe, every Profhilo journey begins with a comprehensive consultation. Your dermatologist assesses your skin condition, hydration levels, laxity, lifestyle, and aesthetic goals to confirm Profhilo is the right treatment for you and design a personalised plan.

2

Skin Cleansing & Preparation

The treatment area is thoroughly cleansed with a medical-grade antiseptic to ensure complete sterility. BAP injection points are identified and marked on the skin based on your individual facial anatomy for optimal product diffusion.

3

BAP Technique Injection (10 Points, Face)

Using the IBSA-approved BAP technique, Profhilo is precisely injected at 5 strategic points on each side of the face â upper cheek, nasal base, lower cheek, jawline, and chin. Each microbolus of 0.2ml is placed subdermally, allowing Profhilo to naturally diffuse throughout the facial tissue. The whole session takes approximately 30 minutes.

4

Immediate Post-Treatment Care

There is no massage required after Profhilo â the product disperses naturally through the skin's mimetic muscle movements over 24 hours. Minor redness or small bumps at injection sites are completely normal and resolve within a few hours.

5

Session 2 â Four Weeks Later

The initial Profhilo course consists of two sessions spaced exactly four weeks apart. The second session reinforces and maximises the bio-remodelling effect, delivering the full transformation â visibly smoother, firmer, and more luminous skin.

6

Maintenance â Every 6 Months

Once the initial two-session course is complete, a maintenance session every 6 months is recommended to sustain and build upon your results. Consistent treatment over time produces cumulative collagen and elastin stimulation for progressively more youthful skin.

Your Care Guide
Pre & Post Treatment Care

Following your care instructions before and after Profhilo ensures the best possible results, supports optimal healing, and maximises the longevity of your treatment.

â¦ Before Your Session

Avoid alcohol for 24 hours before your appointment to reduce bruising risk.
Do not take aspirin, ibuprofen, or blood-thinning supplements for 1 week prior (unless medically required).
Avoid chemical peels, laser treatments, or microneedling for 2 weeks before your session.
Stay out of direct sun and avoid tanning for one week prior.
Avoid Botox or filler treatments in the same area for at least 2 weeks before.
Discontinue Retin-A or AHA skincare products near the treatment area for 1 week prior.
Arrive with clean, makeup-free skin on the treatment area.

â¦ After Your Session

Do not touch, press, or massage the injection sites for at least 24 hours.
Avoid strenuous exercise and excessive sweating for 24 hours post-treatment.
Do not apply makeup directly over injection sites for 12 hours to reduce infection risk.
Drink plenty of water â hydration amplifies the HA benefits and supports skin recovery.
Avoid direct sun, saunas, and steam for 24â48 hours post-treatment.
Apply SPF 30+ daily once healed to protect and prolong your results.
Attend Session 2 exactly 4 weeks after Session 1 for the full Profhilo effect.

Please Note: Small bumps at injection sites immediately after treatment are completely normal â they are simply pools of Profhilo that will naturally disperse over 12â24 hours. Do not massage them. Mild redness may also be present for a few hours.

Your Questions Answered
Frequently Asked Questions

Is Profhilo a filler?

No. Profhilo is a bio-remodelling injectable â completely different from dermal fillers. It does not add volume, change facial contours, or alter your features. Instead, it improves the quality of your skin from within by deeply hydrating and stimulating natural collagen and elastin production. The result is glowing, firmer, more youthful-looking skin.

Is Profhilo painful?

Discomfort is minimal. The BAP technique uses only 5 injection points on each side of the face â far fewer than most injectable treatments. The injections are quick and well-tolerated by most clients. A topical numbing cream can be applied prior to your session if you prefer added comfort.

How many sessions do I need?

The initial Profhilo course consists of two sessions spaced four weeks apart. This two-session protocol completes the bio-remodelling cycle. Thereafter, a single maintenance session every six months is recommended to sustain and build upon your results over time.

When will I see results?

Profhilo delivers progressive improvement, not instant dramatic change. Many clients notice improved hydration and glow after their first session. Full results â firmer skin, refined texture, and an even, luminous complexion â are typically visible 4â6 weeks after the second session, as collagen and elastin production builds naturally.

Is there any downtime after Profhilo?

There is virtually no downtime with Profhilo. Most clients return to their normal daily activities immediately after treatment. Small bumps at injection sites are normal and resolve within 12â24 hours. Mild redness may be present for a few hours. Strenuous exercise should be avoided for 24 hours.

What makes ISAAC Luxe Profhilo special?

At ISAAC Luxe, every Profhilo treatment is performed using the IBSA-approved BAP technique by qualified dermatologists using only 100% authentic IBSA Profhilo. Our personalised approach, luxury clinic environment, and Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta's expert oversight ensure results that are safe, natural, and truly transformative.
